title: Lockheed A-11 – perspective line drawing of design concept
description: Framed perspective line drawing of a slender delta-wing aircraft design with a pointed nose, cockpit and tall vertical fin, captioned "Lockheed A-11." Chapter 6 text (page 269) below discusses the uncertainties of Convair's FISH proposal, cancellation of the B-58B in June 1959, and the Land committee's July 1959 rejection of both designs.
